purpose: HMRC FY2024-25 alcohol clearances by product, ABV band, duty point and relief (Alcohol Bulletin) and tobacco clearances by product (Tobacco Bulletin), HMRC betting and gaming duty cash receipts by duty and Machine Games Duty liabilities by rate band (Betting and Gaming statistics), and the Gambling Commission's FY2024-25 gross gambling yield for Great Britain by sector, activity and betting event: the national quantities and bases the LCFS level_excise_quantities step shares out to households (microcosm#1359, PolicyEngine/chronicle#381).
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.
